newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said.

Inquiry and demand good. Sales confirmed on 22,400 slaughter steers and 16,100 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 85,000 head confirmed including 14,600 head or about 17 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1300 lbs mostly 1150-1225 lbs 69.00; few Select with end Choice 1150-1175 lbs 68.00. Dressed basis - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 112.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 990-1200 lbs mostly 1025-1100 lbs 69.00, one pen 68.50; pen Select with end Choice 1075 lbs 68.00.
Wk to date - 85,000 last week - 61,500 last year - 14,000
